direction: Original Loom family: ivory interlaced paper ribbons on indigo Writer, jade Sheets and coral Present tiles; no Apple artwork used as image input.
artwork_changes: Generated artwork was not repainted; sips performed mechanical size normalization and iconset export, Pillow encoded ICO, iconutil encoded ICNS.

icons.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final original macOS and cross-platform desktop application icon for Loom writer, 1024 by 1024 square, one icon only. Create a refined commercial creative-suite app icon, a coherent family based on interlaced paper ribbons. A single large macOS-compatible rounded-square tile centered with consistent 8% transparent margin around the tile, no surrounding scene. Tile color: deep indigo fading subtly to violet. Symbol: a sculpted ivory ribbon woven into a clear upright page silhouette, with two bold parallel horizontal engraved writing lines and one folded interlaced corner. The silhouette must instantly read as a writing document, yet be original. The central symbol occupies 60% of the tile, strong simple geometry recognizable at 32px, no lettering or words. Carefully crafted shallow dimensional material, satin glass/enamel tile with subtle internal edge light, precise ivory paper ribbon edges, very restrained depth and soft shadow, front view, straight-on, centered and symmetrical visual weight. Light comes from upper left. Elegant and original, clean, restrained, no extra decorative marks, no gradients outside the tile, no watermark. Do not imitate Apple's Pages, Numbers or Keynote symbols or artwork. Output genuinely transparent pixels outside the rounded square. Match the same tile shape, optical margins, lighting, ivory material, depth and geometry across the Loom suite. This is a deliverable app icon, not a mockup or icon sheet.
